children: Injective's Stockdrop goes live on 28 Oct 2026, allowing users who burned INJ to reveal which tokenized stock has been allocated to them and claim it onchain on Solana.
The Stockdrop gives INJ a direct use in tokenized stock distribution by tying access to burning the token. That link could encourage further INJ burning. The distribution size is not stated.
The Injective Stockdrop goes live tomorrow.
Tokenized stock reveal and claims are less than 24 hours away. Ninjas who burned
will see which onchain stock is waiting for them on Solana.

title: Injective: Stockdrop opens tokenized stock claims - 28 Oct 2026
